description: List the controlled vocabularies cdc_discover_datasets' category and tags filters are matched against — every domain category and domain tag the CDC catalog publishes, each with the number of entries carrying it. Call it before filtering a search: a value the catalog does not carry matches nothing and returns an empty page, which is indistinguishable from a real value with no results. All categories come back whole; the tag vocabulary runs to roughly 1,600 values, so tags are ranked by entry count and returned one page at a time via tag_limit and tag_offset. Pass filter to narrow both vocabularies to the values whose words contain it.

domain.description: CDC Socrata host to read the vocabulary from. "data.cdc.gov" (default) and "chronicdata.cdc.gov" front the same catalog and publish the same vocabulary, so this selects which host answers, never which values exist.

filter.description: Narrow both vocabularies to the values related to this text. A value matches when every word of the filter appears inside one of its words ("vaccin" reaches "Vaccinations" and "covid-19 vaccination"), or when the whole value appears in the filter. Matching is not fuzzy — a misspelling returns nothing rather than a guess — and a filter under three letters is ignored.

tag_limit.description: Tags to return in this call (default 50). Tags are ranked by entry count, so the default page is the most-used end of the vocabulary; the response reports how many matched and a nextOffset while more remain. A tag_limit at or above the number of matching tags returns all of them in one call. Categories are never paged — every one arrives whole.

tag_offset.description: Index of the first tag to return, for continuing past a previous call (default 0). Ranking is stable, so tag_offset plus tag_limit walks the vocabulary without gaps or repeats. An offset at or past the number of matching tags returns an empty tag list rather than an error.

name: cdc_list_catalog_vocabulary

cap.description: The tag_limit that bounded this response.

categories.description: Every domain category matching the filter, ranked by entry count. Pass a value to cdc_discover_datasets' category input exactly as spelled here.

items.description: One vocabulary value with its catalog entry count.

datasetCount.description: Catalog entries carrying this value. Charts, maps, stories, files, and links are counted alongside datasets, so this is an upper bound on the queryable entries a filter returns.

value.description: The value as the catalog spells it — pass it verbatim to cdc_discover_datasets. Categories are matched case-sensitively by the catalog; tags case-insensitively.

categoryCount.description: Categories matching the filter. Every one of them is in this response.

domain.description: CDC Socrata host this vocabulary was read from.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `rate_limited`: Socrata API returns 429 Too Many Requests. `dataset_not_found`: Socrata returned 404 for the vocabulary endpoint itself — the Discovery API address is wrong or the service moved. `access_denied`: Socrata returned 403 — the catalog refused this request rather than failing to serve it. `upstream_error`: Socrata catalog API returned a 5xx server error. `invalid_query`: Socrata rejected the vocabulary request with a 400. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

nextOffset.description: Value to pass as tag_offset on the next call to continue after the last tag returned. Present only while matching tags remain.

notice.description: Guidance when the response is a subset of the vocabulary, when a filter too short to discriminate was ignored, when the filter matched nothing, or when tag_offset ran past the end of the matches.

shown.description: Number of tags returned in this response.

tagCount.description: Tags matching the filter, before tag_limit and tag_offset.

tags.description: The requested window of domain tags, ranked by entry count. Pass values to cdc_discover_datasets' tags input; tags union there, so each one added widens the result set.

items.description: One vocabulary value with its catalog entry count.

datasetCount.description: Catalog entries carrying this value. Charts, maps, stories, files, and links are counted alongside datasets, so this is an upper bound on the queryable entries a filter returns.

value.description: The value as the catalog spells it — pass it verbatim to cdc_discover_datasets. Categories are matched case-sensitively by the catalog; tags case-insensitively.

truncated.description: True when the returned tags are a subset of the matching ones. Absent means every matching tag is in this response.

truncationCeiling.description: Upper bound on the entry count of every tag after this page — the tags from nextOffset on. Tags are ranked by entry count, so none of those is carried by more entries than the last tag shown. It does not bound the tags before tag_offset: those rank at or above the first tag shown.

vocabularySize.description: Size of each full vocabulary on this host, before any filter was applied.

categories.description: Domain categories published for this host.

tags.description: Domain tags published for this host.

title: List CDC Catalog Vocabulary
